update.releaseNotes: Development of TasmotaRemota has ended due to Android 16's stricter requirements (SDK 36). The current version remains stable and robust, and will continue to work perfectly on Android 7.0 to 15. For Android 16+ users: We've built a completely new app — Tasmobile HTTP. It is also compatible with Android 7.0 - 15, so here the choice is yours. It has been 100% rewritten for modern standards, with a fresh interface and powerful new features: - Unlimited groups - One-click scenes (RGB, brightness, color temp, relay toggles) for lighting presets - ESP32 energy/sensor logging, charting (14 days - 24h) using Berry Script - ESP8266 logging (24h) using custom Rules - Tasmota Rule Wizard (write Rules without the need to know the syntax and command structure) - Daily energy totals for smart sockets etc. - Tasmota Device network overview (IP addresses, relay numbers, sensors, firmware, hardware, etc) - Auto timezone setup, based on location extracted from phone or tablet - Wear OS smartwatch support for relay control and sensor readings Search for 'Tasmobile HTTP' on Playstore for full details.
